body:
💎 DiamondTrades – Secure & Advanced Player Trading

DiamondTrades is a powerful, secure, and fully customizable player-to-player trading plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers. Built for performance and safety, it provides a smooth GUI-based trading experience with built-in anti-scam protection and economy support.

Perfect for Survival, Lifesteal, SMP, Skyblock, and Network servers.

~~--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

✨ Features

🔒 Advanced Anti-Scam Protection
Automatic trade cancel if items are modified during confirmation.

🖥️ Clean & Modern GUI System
Easy-to-use trading interface with confirmation buttons.

💰 Economy Support (Vault Compatible)
Trade money alongside items.

🔄 Two-Step Confirmation System
Both players must confirm before the trade completes.

🚫 Auto Cancel Conditions

Player moves too far

Player logs out

Player dies

Inventory full

⚡ Optimized & Lightweight
Designed for high-performance servers with minimal lag.

~~--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

📜 Commands

/trade <player> – Send a trade request

/trade accept – Accept a request

/trade deny – Deny a request


~~--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

🔐 Permissions

diamondtrades.use

~~--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

🧩 Compatible With

Supports Minecraft 1.21 - 1.21.11

Works with Vault-based economy plugins

Compatible with Paper, Spigot, and Bukkkit
